policy.termination: append deterministic attempt windows and merge all windows until a complete window verifies at least 1000000000 unique canonical pairs

envelope.timeout_headroom_note: The four-hour product envelope includes both certification test commands. Provisioning and runner registration happen before dispatch and are bounded separately by the five-hour infrastructure TTL; they are never excluded from billed-cost approval.

sut.workspace_binding: process TMPDIR and GitHub RUNNER_TEMP must resolve to the same local-NVMe filesystem
sut.runner_lifecycle: unique ephemeral repository runner; deregister and destroy after evidence upload

required_before_provisioning: explicit resource creation and spend ceiling
approved exact provider, region, SKU, image version, runner label, and teardown owner

negative_drills.invariant: no partial publication, no addressable partial candidate, and the last complete atomic phase journal remains valid

identity_reconciliation.transport: bundle transport digest distinct from semantic package digest
identity_reconciliation.authority: source and imported ontology/capability fingerprints must match
identity_reconciliation.project: source and imported canonical project fingerprints must match
identity_reconciliation.queries: source and imported 1-hop and 2-hop observation fingerprints must match
